# ViraStack

> DX-first open-source toolkit for React frontend developers: production starters, agent architecture rules, headless form utilities, and an interactive modern-web guide. MIT licensed.

Prefer product `llms-full.txt` files for API detail. Use this file as the curated ecosystem map. Primary language for docs and packages is English.

Package versions (approx.): `virastack@1.0.5`, `@virastack/mask@1.1.1`, `@virastack/password@1.0.2`, `@virastack/ai@1.3.1`.

## Products

- [Start](https://virastack.com/start): CLI (`npx virastack@latest`) to scaffold Next.js or TanStack Start apps
- [AI](https://virastack.com/ai): Agent rules and architecture kit (`npx @virastack/ai init`)
- [Mask](https://virastack.com/mask): React Hook Form input masking (`@virastack/mask`)
- [Password](https://virastack.com/password): Accessible password visibility toggle (`@virastack/password`)
- [Guide](https://virastack.com/guide): Interactive “modern web” walkthrough

## LLM indexes

- [Start llms.txt](https://virastack.com/start/llms.txt): Start docs map
- [Start llms-full.txt](https://virastack.com/start/llms-full.txt): Start CLI, templates, flags (full)
- [AI llms.txt](https://virastack.com/ai/llms.txt): AI product map
- [AI llms-full.txt](https://virastack.com/ai/llms-full.txt): AI CLI, injected rules, usage (full)
- [Mask llms.txt](https://virastack.com/mask/llms.txt): Mask docs map
- [Mask llms-full.txt](https://virastack.com/mask/llms-full.txt): useViraMask API, presets, examples (full)
- [Password llms.txt](https://virastack.com/password/llms.txt): Password docs map
- [Password llms-full.txt](https://virastack.com/password/llms-full.txt): useViraPassword API and a11y (full)
- [Guide llms.txt](https://virastack.com/guide/llms.txt): Guide step map
- [Guide llms-full.txt](https://virastack.com/guide/llms-full.txt): Guide narrative and stack (full)
- [Ecosystem llms-full.txt](https://virastack.com/llms-full.txt): Combined overview + quick APIs

## Human docs

- [Start docs](https://virastack.com/start/docs): Install, CLI, templates, scripts, i18n
- [Mask docs](https://virastack.com/mask/docs): Hook, custom masks, validation, helpers, examples
- [Password docs](https://virastack.com/password/docs): Hook, accessibility, customization, examples

## Packages

- [`virastack`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/virastack): Scaffold CLI (Start)
- [`@virastack/ai`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@virastack/ai): Shared agent rules for scaffolds
- [`@virastack/mask`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@virastack/mask): Input masks for React + React Hook Form
- [`@virastack/password`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@virastack/password): Password visibility hook for React
